title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind

memorableQuote: Please let me keep this memory, just this one.

reflections.note: I stumbled onto this movie by total accident a long time ago, and I’ve gone back to it more times than I can count. Back then, it grabbed hold of me completely—probably because, as someone who has always been a bit of a loner, I saw so much of myself in Joel. What strikes me looking back is that, for a romance, it never tries to sell you on obvious, idealized love. As we move backward through their memories, they are messy, flawed, and uncertain—and that’s precisely what makes it feel so real. Watching it again recently, I noticed even more layers: the script is extraordinary, and the music, cinematography, and acting all complete one another. It reminds me that you can’t wall yourself off from living or loving just out of fear of getting hurt or losing someone.
